sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Native 156x210 image: elderly woman facing nearly forward, eyes slightly toward viewer left, closed level mouth, swept side-part silver-white waved bob curling around both ears and grey brows. Dark blue-grey broad-lapel overcoat, pale grey-green inner fabric with burgundy V edge, partly bottom-cropped small silver diamond-shaped lapel brooch at viewer left, cool textured blue background. Preserve hair, brows, brooch, gaze, closed-mouth seriousness, coat style and layered V neckline; fit neckline to a compact rounded mascot head with short broad neck transition. No inferred text or identity.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Distinct native 312x420 source, not byte-identical to the small DDS: near-frontal elderly woman with swept silver-white side-part waves and grey brows, closed serious mouth, dark blue-grey broad lapels, pale grey-green inner garment edged burgundy at the V neck, clearly visible bottom-cropped silver diamond brooch on viewer-left lapel; cool blue painted background. Preserve exact crop, source hair/brows, brooch, layered V-neck clothing, gaze and lighting, adjusting collar/shoulders for the mascot's short broad neck. Do not borrow the small source's pixels or invent identity.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman almost frontal, short silver-grey softly waved bob and grey brows, small round dark-rim glasses centered over the eyes; serious closed mouth. Dark brown/charcoal blazer, round red brooch with gold rim on viewer-left lapel, cream pointed-collar shirt with black bow tie and small grey center knot. On viewer right, source-cropped orange-brown book or folder edges and a thin black pen/ruler are visibly held in front; preserve their placement and crop without inventing an unseen hand. Textured blue background. Keep hair, glasses eye placement, brow visibility, brooch and shirt/bow; use short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman near frontal, silver-grey waved hair and grey brows, burgundy pillbox-style hat with a dark rolled fabric flower on viewer-right upper edge, small gold flower-like earrings, serious closed mouth. Rust-red lapelled outer coat, peach pointed shirt collar and one large dark round button below it. At viewer-right lower corner a cropped dark green/black rectangular measuring instrument has a yellow semicircular dial and a lower circular dark feature; tiny markings are unreadable and must not become invented text. Blue painted backdrop. Preserve accessories, hat flower, hair, pose, clothing and crop with compact round mascot head and short broad collar transition.
